The subject of these triples is `http://org.example.com/aHR0cHM6Ly9leGFtcGxlLm9yZy9zbS90ZXAtb3BjdWEtY29ubmVjdGl2aXR5LWluc3RhbmNl/U2lnbmFsTWFwcGluZ3MuUmVhY3RvclRlbXBlcmF0dXJl` (a URI representing the OPC UA connection).
